newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 196-day T-bill yields average 27.90 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian 196-day T-bill yields average 27.90 pct.

text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of 196-day discount Treasury bills amounted to 27.90 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the central bank said.
Dealers had forecast the average yield would be between 29.49 and 35.42 percent.
The series 22065 bills, maturing on August 20, the closest maturity date to the new issue, closed at 27.49 percent on Tuesday.
The 22065 bills are tax-exempt. The new issue is subject to a new 15-percent tax on government securities.

On February 11, the finance ministry raised about 5.59 trillion roubles ($988.9 million) by selling 287-day T-bills (series 22072), making total proceeds from Wednesday's auctions 9.29 trillion roubles.
It has also repaid about 7.66 trillion roubles in maturing six-month T-bills (series 22042).
